description: Fetch a Pinterest user's public profile and one content tab. Always returns profile metadata (display name, bio, avatar, follower/following counts, monthly views, external links). The tab parameter selects what else to load: saved (the user's Boards — their curated Pin collections, default) or created (Pins the user originally published). Requires a logged-in browser session.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Pinterest username — the segment in the profile URL https://www.pinterest.com/<username>/. Obtain it from search --type user results or the creator field of get-pin / get-feed output.

parameters.name: tab
parameters.description: Which profile tab to return: saved (Boards the user saves Pins into — the profile default view) | created (Pins the user originally published, at /<username>/_created/).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of boards (tab=saved) or Pins (tab=created) to return (1-100, default 20). Lazy-loads on scroll; returns fewer with partial=true if the feed is exhausted.
